notes.overdrawn: You have taken more leave than has accrued so far.
notes.rules: Bahrain private-sector employees get 30 calendar days of paid annual leave a year. Leave accrues at 2.5 days for each completed month, and unused leave is paid out in cash when employment ends.
notes.disclaimer: Estimate only. The cash value uses a daily rate of monthly wage divided by 30, and your contract may set a more generous entitlement. Confirm with your employer or the Labour Market Regulatory Authority.
